{{Documentation subpage}}
'''Template:Auto short description''' should be placed on documentation pages of templates which automatically generate short description for pages transcluding them.

Pages tagged with this template are categorized in {{cl|Templates that generate short descriptions}}.

== Usage ==
{{Tlx|{{BASEPAGENAME}}}}

== Parameters ==
{| class="wikitable"
|+ Parameters
|-
! scope="col" style="width: 15%;" | Parameter
! scope="col" | Description
|-
! scope="row" | {{para|sometimes}}
| Any value will change "adds an automatically generated [[Wikipedia:Short description|short description]]" to "sometimes adds an automatically generated [[Wikipedia:Short description|short description]]" . Use for templates that only generate short descriptions under particular conditions.
|-
! scope="row" | {{para|indirect}}
| For templates that generate short descriptions via another template that is always embedded.
|-
! scope="row" | {{para|conditions}}
| When an explanation is desired for the conditions under which a short description is generated, e.g. when the short description template is wrapped with {{tl|Namespace detect}}.
|-
! scope="row" | {{para|category}}
| For meta-templates that generate short descriptions for a family of templates. For example, adding {{para|chemical elements}} will categorize the templates in {{cl|Templates that generate short descriptions for chemical elements}}.
|}

== Examples ==
* {{Suppress categories|{{Tlx|{{BASEPAGENAME}}|_show_result=y}}}}
* {{Suppress categories|{{Tlx|{{BASEPAGENAME}}|sometimes{{=}}yes|_show_result=y}}}}
* {{Suppress categories|{{Tlx|{{BASEPAGENAME}}|indirect{{=}}yes|_show_result=y}}}}
* {{Suppress categories|{{Tlx|{{BASEPAGENAME}}|conditions{{=}}when it is used in Wikipedia space|_show_result=y}}}}
* {{Suppress categories|{{Tlx|{{BASEPAGENAME}}|category{{=}}chemical elements|_show_result=y}}}}
